field_edits.updated_text: Acute mildly displaced fracture involving the distal humerus, centered at the supracondylar/intercondylar region. Fracture extension into the articular surface cannot be excluded. Alignment is maintained. No acute focal osseous lesion elsewhere.
Elbow joint effusion is present. No dislocation is seen. The joint spaces are preserved.
Associated soft tissue swelling is present.

impression:
